# EasyOps

> EasyOps turns every wholesale purchase order into a living, AI-powered workspace — one place to see everything, take action, and automate deduction recovery and compliance for CPG brands selling through KeHE, UNFI, and other distributors.

## Solutions by category
- [Food & Beverage](https://tryeasyops.com/solutions/food-beverage): Deduction recovery for grocery and beverage brands — fill-rate fees, OTD penalties, cut cases.
- [Supplements & Vitamins](https://tryeasyops.com/solutions/supplements): Deduction recovery for VMS brands — short-date markdowns, labeling compliance, high-value SKU margin protection.
- [Health, Beauty & Personal Care](https://tryeasyops.com/solutions/health-beauty): Deduction recovery for HBA brands — damage claims, MAP/pricing, new-item and slotting fees.

## Product
- [Deduction recovery](https://tryeasyops.com/deduction-recovery): Trace every KeHE deduction to the rule that caused it and find disputable chargebacks in minutes.
- [KeHE compliance guide](https://tryeasyops.com/kehe-compliance-guide): Reference for KeHE chargeback codes and compliance rules.
